Today we’re happy to announce that the Guild Wars 2 core game is available for everyone to play for free. With Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns™ launching soon, there’s no better time to introduce the game to your friends.

As a Guild Wars 2[1] player myself, and after reviewing the restrictions, I welcome this change. This has opened up a huge way to allow newcomers to try this game before putting any money down. GW2 isn't exactly in need of more players, at least in the NA region, but more the merrier! The only drawback is that I would have preferred if they still allowed the purchase of the core game for X amount so that people that want restrictions removed, but don't want to commit to buying the new expansion, can choose to just buy the core game or the expansion+core game.

As for restrictions, they are rather lenient, mostly chat and map areas being level locked, however I'd say the Login Rewards being disabled is one of the biggest restrictions since you're losing free extra character levels, laurels, boosters, and end game crafting materials every month.

I guess we'll see how this works out for GW2 and ArenaNet[2], this isn't exactly a huge thing to gamble with since it comes with heavy restrictions, but it does set a precedent for future Anet games and also future expansions for GW2.
